effect_description_eng: [Main] By trashing any 1 digivolution card of 1 of your Digimon with the [Mineral] or [Rock] trait, until the end of your opponent's turn, that Digimon gains ＜Collision＞ (During this Digimon's attack, all of your opponent's Digimon gain ＜Blocker＞, and must block if possible.), ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.), ＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.), and your opponent's effects can't return it to hands or decks, and it gets +3000 DP.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest play cost.
